title: Speckled granite
purpose: Generate tileable PBR maps of granite and similar crystalline stone: interlocking feldspar, quartz and dark mineral grains, optional large crystals, from polished to flamed. Use for counters, paving, cladding and monuments.

contract.signature: generate(width=256, height=256, seed=0, preset="default", directx_normal=False, **parameters) -> {map name: {"channels", "colour_space", "pixels"}}
contract.command_line: python granite_speckled.py --size 1024 --seed 7 --preset NAME --out DIR [--width W --height H] [--set NAME=VALUE] [--directx-normal] [--orm]

parameters.name: grains_across
parameters.meaning: Mineral grains across the tile (higher is finer).

parameters.name: feldspar
parameters.meaning: Share of feldspar grains (the main colour).

parameters.name: dark_minerals
parameters.meaning: Share of dark mica and hornblende grains; the rest is quartz.

parameters.name: phenocrysts
parameters.meaning: Amount of large blocky feldspar crystals.

parameters.name: finish
parameters.meaning: Surface finish from polished (0) through honed to flamed (1).

parameters.name: hue_shift
parameters.meaning: Hue rotation of the albedo in turns.

presets.name: default
presets.description: Polished grey granite: white feldspar, grey quartz, black mica.

presets.name: rose
presets.description: Polished pink granite with salmon feldspar and large crystals.

presets.name: black_galaxy
presets.description: Polished black stone with sparse bronze flecks.

presets.name: flamed_grey
presets.description: Flamed grey granite: rough, matte, quartz raised.

presets.name: blue_larvikite
presets.description: Blue-grey stone with large feldspar crystals and a soft sheen.

limits: Grains are Voronoi cells with one colour each, an approximation of crystal fabric; there is no twinning beyond a single line, no reflective flake and no real mineral optics. Colours are artistic, not matched to named quarries. Occlusion is a blurred-height estimate.
technique_references: Worley noise cells as mineral grains
Weighted per-cell hashing for mineral choice
Rotated rectangle stamps with clipped corners for phenocrysts
Finish-dependent relief and roughness per mineral
Height to tangent-space normal by central differences
